reviews.text: Truly a great vet office! From the moment you walk in to when you leave, they make you feel so welcome and take such good care of my dog. They always go over pricing and never make me feel pressured to do anything, while still making sure I understand what they recommend and what they think is best for my dog’s health. You can also tell that the entire staff genuinely loves every patient that comes through their doors. They give each one so much attention, and it really warms my heart to see because that’s exactly what all of our pets deserve🫶🏽

Multiple BLVD vets missed that my dog had toe cancer. They insisted tested for cushings disease multiple times then realized he had a broken nail which they partially removed. All of this costing thousands of dollars while missing the main cause of my dog’s. Health issues… cancer which they didn’t even test for nor took x-rays of his foot. We went elsewhere to get the diagnosis and treatment that led to our dog being healthy again. Would not recommend BLVD as they seemed more interested in running expensive tests than healing our beloved family pet.

Thank you for the 5 stars Dorothea! We're so glad you and your pet had a great experience with our Ravenswood team. We appreciate you trusting BLVD Vet with their care and look forward to seeing you both at your next visit.

Beware of extreme pricing: BLVD gave me an estimate of $515 for a regular annual exam of a healthy cat. This includes them charging $159 for an annual rabies vaccine. Roughly 5-8x the average cost of a rabies vaccine in Chicago. I was so shocked by an annual visit being over 500 dollars that I asked them to review the estimate and they have confirmed this is their pricing. I am sure they do great work here but I do need to let other customers know of this inflated pricing.

Recently moved to the area and needed a new vet for my Sphynx. Amazing service, very attentive and friendly. Doctor explained everything in detail and did not try to push any extra tests or services. I am pleasantly surprised and would recommend. I had experienced a few clinics with my older pets and this is the best experience so far. Very pleased.
Great friendly staff!

I WANT TO THANK THE EXCELLENT  STAFF AND DR.MUNOZ AT BLVD VET FOR THE CARE THEY GAVE MY 15 YEAR  OLD CAT MARLEY, ON  SATURDAY  AUGUST 1ST,  MARLEY CAME IN WITH SOME TUMMY TROUBLES AND WAS  EXAMINED,  AND SENT HOME WITH SOME MEDS,  AND NOW IS FEELING  MUCH BETTER  THANK BLD VET

I brought my dog Buffy to BLVD Vet Ravenswood in early 2024. He was having digestive issues that his previous vet claimed was due to “old age” since he was 9 at the time, but I wanted a second opinion. During his first visit, a plan was made to change his diet to rule out allergies. His new diet worked and it was like he changed overnight. He no longer had digestive issues and also regained his energy. I was so happy my concerns were heard and it wasn’t an issue that was dismissed because he was a senior dog.

I’m so glad I made BLVD Vet his primary vet after that visit. Buffy had terrible anxiety at the vet, but everyone in the staff was very accommodating to his needs during routine visits. They allowed me to hold him during routine shots and also let him stay in his stroller where he was most comfortable.

I lost Buffy back in June very unexpectedly. A few days after, I received flowers from BLVD Vet extending their condolences. It was so touching to receive during deep grief. A few weeks after, I received a condolences card from the staff that worked with Buffy and again was thankful they extended compassion and care.

I hope to work with BLVD Vet again with future pets.

Extremely caring and thoughful vet practise. From the check-in to the techs to the veterinarians. Everyone is caring and supportive. We switched to BLVD after our previous vet was sold to a private equity firm. A the old vet we felt like we became a "profit center" to be rushed in and out. BLVD is a breath of fresh air.
BLVD and their vets were so accommodating and helpful for my dog's first vet appointment. Commitment and attention to detail were super helpful and am so grateful for their kindness!

We have been bringing our cat Cinder to Boulevard Ravenswood to several years now. They do such a fantastic job and everyone here is so kind and incredibly helpful. From emergency visits to routine care, BLVD has taken great care of my little guy.

Was first patien in morning on Wednesday this week. They took my chihuahua in immediately for his 2 procedures with vet assistant. She was very kind and caring and gentle with him. I was only waiting in lobby 10 minutes, but was amazed at cleanliness of reception area and beyond . Floors/rugs, bathroom all perfect and spotlessly cleaned. I work in a peoples Dr s office in the suburbs, and it is never kept this clean! Great job BLVD !
Kind, caring, compassionate and thorough!

Dr. Raju was the first vet who truly took my concerns seriously when I noticed tiny skin bumps on my cat. Multiple vets had dismissed them as too small to biopsy, but Dr. Raju was able to aspirate one of the lesions and identify mast cells, which led to surgery and removal of all three tumors.

Because of her thoroughness, my kitty is now cancer free. I’m incredibly grateful for her skill, compassion, and proactive approach.

We recently spent around $800 trying to determine what was wrong with our dog’s urine. Unfortunately, after visiting and additional testing, we were once again told that everything appears to be “fine.”
At this point, it’s becoming extremely frustrating. There is clearly something abnormal going on, yet we still have no answers or resolution despite the significant amount of money we’ve spent. We’re beginning to feel that it may be time to find a new veterinarian who is willing to look deeper into the issue and help us get to the root of the problem.
I wish they would open the door for me when I’m brining in my cats.

Bisco (my Great Dane) is convinced this place exists solely to admire him—and honestly, the staff doesn’t do much to prove him wrong. From the moment we walk in, they’re excited to see him and treat him like absolute royalty. He struts in like he owns the place, and they’re right there ready to hype him up.

On a serious note, they’re incredibly kind, attentive, and make every visit easy and stress-free. Bisco gives it 5 paws (even though he only has 4). Highly recommend!

Thank you for the 5-star rating James! We truly appreciate your support! It means a lot to our team to know we’re delivering a great experience. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!

Sincerely,
Yesenia
Ravenswood Practice Manager

Thank you for the positive rating Diana! We truly appreciate your support and are glad you had a great experience with our team. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon. 🐾

Sincerely,
Yesenia
Ravenswood Practice Manager
Our dog Maggie loves going to Blvd Vet Ravenswood - such fantastic staff and facilities.
We are pleased with the warm and friendly care that our cats are receiving here. Nice bright office, and a cheerful staff.

This is a dishonest practice. They sold me expensive testing and the results did not agree with other testing they also sold me -- they refused to repeat the test which was obviously wrong unless I paid for it a second time. These guys are happy to take your money so long as you never push back.

Dr. Raju and Logan were AMAZING!!! Literally sat on the floor to engage with my doggy and kept me in the loop 100%. Even offered their condolences on the loss of my other pup. Definitely my go to vet- thank you for calming my anxieties while taking good care of Kash!

We’ve been taking our miniature dachshund to BLVD since adopting him in July 2025. The care during routine visits was generally fine and the vet techs are great, though pricing tends to be on the higher side.

Where things broke down was when we tried to schedule his neuter. Throughout multiple visits, we received mixed messaging about whether the procedure could be performed at BLVD or would need to be outsourced. When I eventually called to schedule and followed up again, it took nearly two weeks for the clinic to confirm that they could not perform the procedure in-house.

If the clinic wasn’t comfortable handling the surgery, that should have been communicated clearly and promptly so we could make other arrangements. Surgical planning shouldn’t take weeks without proactive communication.

Adding to the frustration, the neuter estimate provided by BLVD was roughly $1,000 higher than the quote we received from another reputable Chicago clinic for the same procedure. Pet owners may want to compare pricing at other clinics (for example, Tree House Veterinary Wellness Center) before scheduling.

Due to the lack of communication, we’ve decided to seek alternative vet care moving forward.

I always judge a vet by thier care for my dog, thier willingness to accomodate and find ways to avoid stressing them.  BLVD is the single best vet i have found by this metric.  They spent time,  to socialize and meet my dog, didn't remove them from the exam room for trratment when it was clear that being seprated made her nervous, and generally exceeded my expectations across the board.  I moved to them for the convience of a closer location, but they so exceeded the qualoty of care i expected.
BLVD Ravenswood is the absolute best. The veterinarian Suma has gone above and beyond regarding treating a pesky and recalcitrant infection on my dog’s paw.

BLVD Ravenswood is wonderful. They are kind, patient, and thoughtful. My dog has been going through a rare, complex case and they have taken time to answer questions, explain the condition, address concerns, etc. They truly care for the animals they see and they spend time to make sure their owners understand and are comfortable. I recommend them without hesitation.
Called my golden retriever aggressive, I’ll leave it at that

my husband and i brought in our adopted daughter (cat), Margot Tenenbaum, and everyone we encountered was so great. The people at the front desk are so nice. Dr. Silberman was very sweet with Margot and was very informative, taking her time answer our many questions. Special shout out to Logan, our tech, who really went the extra step for us as far as helping us with registering her microchip, giving us further information and giving Margot snuggles and treats. Thank you Boulevard! 😊
Switching my pup to this vet and the team has been INCREDIBLE and helpful and patient and kind through this process. I am so grateful!

When my sweet puppy passed away they made me feel so comforted with flowers and cards. It meant the world to me during one of the worst times. When she was still with us, they were so welcoming from
the moment I walked through the doors. Dr. Courville explained everything so well and really took the time to make sure I understood what was going on with my precious girl during her last few months. Thank you thank you!!

It’s incredibly disappointing to witness the decline in service, as many others have also noted. It feels as though profits and price tags are being prioritized over genuine care and assistance for a well-documented issue with my dog.

While I remain grateful for the compassion shown when I had to put my other dog down, it’s disheartening to see that same level of care isn’t extended to the pets who are still with us. For that reason, we’ll be taking our business and our two other dogs, elsewhere.

Thank you for sharing this feedback Anthony. We’re sorry to hear you feel this way about the cost of care at BLVD Vet. Our team strives to provide gold-standard veterinary medicine with transparent pricing that reflects the high quality of our services, advanced diagnostics, and the compassionate attention given to every pet and pet parent. 

We would love the opportunity to learn more about your experience. If you’re open to it, please reach out to our management team so we can better understand how to improve and ensure your next visit is a positive one.  

Sincerely,
Yesenia
Ravenswood Practice Manager

We’re grateful for your 5-star feedback! Our mission at BLVD Vet Ravenswood in Chicago is to provide gentle, knowledgeable care that helps pets live their healthiest, happiest lives.

Sincerely,
Yesenia
Ravenswood Practice Manager

We are so grateful for the patience and expertise at BLVD Vet Ravenswood. Dr. Silberman and all the vet techs have shown exceptional care and gentleness towards our two cats, especially to our deaf kitty Pippa who also suffers from a heart condition. They are always so thoughtful and patient with Pippa, and I always leave feeling thankful for their kindness and care. They go the extra mile to remember what works best for our cats in feeling comfortable and even make sure to have lots of Churu on hand to distract! We are so glad to have found such a trustworthy practice!

Unfortunately, BLVD has just gotten too big for its britches and is placing the bottom line and process over patient care.

The last several visits have just been progressively worse--clearly they're declining in quality of care.

Every appointment requires me to rehash the entirety of my dogs health history--it's like no one is reading the charts or taking time to understand the dogs.

My dog Walter had a fatty lump on his head.  Each time I asked about it, I was told "we'll keep an eye on it", but each time we went in again, it was like it was brand new. When I asked if it grew or not, they couldn't tell me since the records apparently didn't have the measurements from the previous visit--even though they tried to aspirate it every trip.

The last time I took Walter in, I was scheduled for a vet tech appointment at 2:45.  I waited an hour for them to finally get him, only for him to be back there for less than 10 mins.  $200 appointment.

The most recent visit was today, for my dog Felix, where I had a confirmation from their text service that I had an appointment at 2:00.  When I get there, nobody on their end had actually scheduled the appointment so I took time off of work, drugged my senior dog for the appt, and got told "come back tomorrow at 5:15" (and I still don't have a confirmation email about this appointment).

It's clear that there's a massive gulf between the front desk and the practitioners which just creates a massive gulf between the practice and the patients.

You're better off going somewhere where you're a patient and not a number.

Thank you so much for your 5-stars Morgan! We’re thrilled to know you had a positive experience with our team at BLVD Vet Ravenswood. Our doctors and staff are committed to providing compassionate, high-quality veterinary care for pets and their families in Chicago. We look forward to caring for you all again at future visits!

Sincerely,
Yesenia
Ravenswood Practice Manager

This is the best vet I've ever experienced. We have been taking our Shih Tzu dogs here for a few months and everyone is so kind and warm. The front desk people make me feel like my dogs are the best things (they are, but it's still nice to hear), and the doctors/techs/assistants have been so lovely and informative. If you're looking for a place to bring your beloved pet, look no further!

I cannot say enough wonderful things about BLVD Vet Ravenswood. I recently had to make the incredibly difficult decision to say goodbye to my sweet furry companion of nearly 20 years. The team at BLVD Vet was nothing short of extraordinary. They were kind, compassionate, and deeply supportive throughout the entire process.

Dr. Suma Raju guided me with such empathy and grace, making an unbearable moment feel surrounded by love. I never imagined something so painful could be met with such tenderness.

I’m forever grateful for the years they cared for my sweet boy and for the beautiful farewell they helped me give him. My heart aches, but it’s also full of gratitude.
Great caring vet and staff for our old cats

BLVD has restored my faith in vets! After our last vet moved and the office itself was taken over by a private equity company, I knew we needed a new home to take our pets that was locally owned. Needless to say, BLVD has checked all the boxes and Dr. Munoz is a favorite of ours. Our cat even had a teeth cleaning here and though we were perhaps more scared than she was, we knew she was in the BEST of hands! We look forward to bringing our pets here for years to come.

Hi Crystal,
Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We're thrilled to hear you had a great experience. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you again soon! 💛

Sincerely,
Yesenia
Ravenswood Practice Manager

Truly the best experience I’ve had taking my cat to the vet. My cat was treated with the utmost respect and care during her visit. She’s never left the vet so relaxed but she did after her visit to BLVD.

My Tank (4 year old shih tzu) is a nervous wreck around vets and groomers due to past terrible experiences. He needed blood drawn but would not let them get a good vein. It took three visits but  only because they took their time, didn’t force him out of his comfort zone (or mine) and tested out different medications to help with his anxiety during these visits. I am EXTREMELY grateful to have found a place I trust with my little one!

Unbelievably kind, knowledgeable, and caring staff. And transparent pricing which I’ve learned is not always the norm with vets! This is our new vet for life, truly the best experience we’ve had and made a stressful situation much better. Lyndon also gives 5 stars!
My dog loves Dr Courvelle
Everyone was so nice! My pups and I had such a great experience. I'm so glad we found this place!

Took my mothers dog here for a visit when he had an unknown leg injury. He’s been a patient there for a couple years, but it was my first time there. The whole staff, from the front desk to the vet techs and vets were so friendly, recognized him and made him comfortable, and worked quickly and efficiently to diagnose and provide us with treatment options. They answered all questions and made sure we understood the meds and treatments. They called back early the next day with test results. Plus, their facility is clean, modern, and comfortable for both pets and owners (they even have a separate waiting room for cats!). Overall this was a great experience during a stressful situation, and we really appreciated the whole team!

We started going to BLVD Vet Ravenswood about 3 years and had a pretty good experience up until about a year ago. My dog, Penny, has had quite a few visits this past year and I’ve been disappointed every time. She had a surgery 3 years ago for reoccurring abscesses and was under BLVD Vets care while this was going on. I also sent the results/findings to BLVD after the surgery & I believe the surgeon talked on the phone with them as well. Her first sick visit this year I noticed they didn’t have any record of her surgery anymore. She has a lopsided mouth & when I rescued her they explained she could have been attacked when she was a stray or it could just be a birth defect. When she had the surgery it revealed she had fractures along that side of her face & she was partially paralyzed indicating it was not a birth defect and that she was attacked. When we went to this sick appointment the vet explained for 10 minutes about her lopsided mouth and how it was a birth defect and how if it was affecting her they could do something about it which thoroughly annoyed me because 1. I’ve had her for over 4 years and if it was bothering her I would have done something about it 2. If they had her surgery records or bothered to look at them they would know what her history was and wouldn’t have spent the time explaining the wrong thing to me. In between the next two visits I visited BLVD Lakeview because I believe her old vet she had at Ravenswood moved to Lakeview when they opened. I did not get the same vet at Lakeview, and when I went back to Ravenswood they didn’t have any record of her visit to the Lakeview location. They told me she was overdue for her heartworm test when I had it done a month before at the Lakeview location. Everytime I’ve gone there recently she’s had a different vet & vet tech and I don’t think they’ve looked at her records or kept proper record of her medical history. Penny has numerous random health issues and has been going to the vet pretty frequently since I adopted her. When we’ve gone to BLVD recently it’s felt like we’ve had to re-explain her entire medical history to every new vet when her history should be taken into consideration when examining her current health concerns. She’s had ongoing unexplained anal gland issues since October 2024 & I was trying to stick it out with BLVD until the issues were resolved but they essentially didn’t give me any answers or help so I ended up having to go to BondVet instead & just recently fully switched to Ravenswood Animal Hospital who has been a huge help & I’ve really enjoyed so far. This isn’t even mentioning how overpriced BLVD is. Penny’s annual was in December, and I was pretty certain she had an ear infection at that time as well. We went in for her annual and asked for an ear cytology & she ended up having a mild ear infection. When I got the bill they charged two $100 exam fees ($100 for the annual exam fee & $100 for a “sick” exam fee). This is literally insane because I literally went in and TOLD them she had an ear infection & they were already doing a physical exam for her annual????? The only additional things they did for the ear infection was the ear cytology and medicine & I had already paid for both of those so why are you charging me $200 dollars just for her to be seen by a vet??? Anyway those are all my complaints :)
Everyone is always so kind and gracious to us. They make Sasha Lee feel so content and comfortable during her visits. We can't thank you enough!

If you're thinking about taking your pet here - DO IT they are the most kind loving compassionate vets I have had the pleasure of working with. My beloved Siamese boy Corki had to leave us due to cancer and Dr. Raju and her team held our hands and hearts during the worst time of our lives with the most gentle and kind approach.  No one wants to hear "your cat has cancer - the kind you can only make them comfortable until they tell you it's time" but when they had to they felt the pain with us. When it came time for him to leave us they set the space up so we could have as much time as we needed - they explained everything as it happened and had open arms for hugs when he was gone.  As we left they cried with us - this isn't just a vets office. It's a family. We are so very lucky we found BLVD Ravenswood and we hope to stay here a long time. Thanks for all you do for Corki Bella and Maple ♡

We are so grateful there are vets that exist like BLVD. We appreciate the skill, care, and anxiety minimizing approach to treating our little guy who has historically been very fearful of going to the vet before finding BLVD. From vet techs and doctors who will literally sit on the floor and complete a full medical exam on a blanket where our little guy is most comfortable, to texting recommendations during some of our toughest moments, the staff at BLVD has consistently gone above and beyond. While Dr. Munoz, Dr. Silberman, Dr. Bean, Logan, and Daniel have been incredibly knowledgeable, their compassion and empathy is unmatched. Thank you for providing comfort and relief on some of our toughest days, BLVD! We appreciate you.

I've been taking our cat to Boulevard Vet Ravenswood for almost 3 years now. Everyone there has always been very nice and professional. Recently, we had a serious issue come up requiring major surgery for our cat. These are the situations where you really need to be able to trust a vet can provide quality care for your pet. I can't say enough good things about Dr Muñoz and her staff. The surgery was successful and everyone at Boulevard was positive and helpful and willing to answer all of my questions or concerns. I know there are some other comments complaining about the pricing, but I think they are priced very fairly considering the location and the level of service provided. I have recommended Boulevard Vet to my friends and I will continue to trust Dr Muñoz and her team with our cat.

AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COSTS – I had a terrible experience here and want to warn others. They added unnecessary charges and made me spend way more than expected. DR. SUMA RAJU was my vet, and I was billed for things my pet never even received. It felt like a scam designed to meet a daily quota or cover overhead costs. Please don’t make the same mistake I did. Take your pet somewhere else. AVOID, AVOID, AVOID.

I cannot say enough good things about BLVD Vet! Every time my cat has had an issue, they have been extremely responsive and caring. They are honest about what is needed and what can wait, and always provide me with additional resources that help at home. It was a relief to find them after going elsewhere in the city!
Great care and service. Reasonable price . I like everything about this place.
KC was amazing along with all the other vet staff and makes you and your pet feel right at home! 🙏💯🫶 …

I had a mixed experience with this veterinary clinic. Our first visit was great, and I appreciated their care for my dog. However, my second appointment was canceled just 10 minutes before the scheduled time, which was very frustrating. I spent $24 on an Uber round trip for nothing. While they did offer a credit for the next visit, I feel this situation could have been handled much better. Last-minute cancellations inconvenience clients and disrupt plans. I hope they improve their communication and scheduling practices in the future.

Dr. Raju and all of the techs and support staff at this location have gone above and beyond to provide excellent care for both of my dogs. One of my dogs needs to be sedated for his exams/vaccines and everyone went out of their way to accommodate him and make the visit as stressless as possible. Dr. Raju (and the techs!) have been incredibly thorough and thoughtful with their explanations and I’ve never felt rushed. They’re upfront and transparent about their pricing and treatment options. I cannot recommend this place enough!

I've been taking my babies (Cats) to Blvd Vet for a couple of years and everyone there is really really great...they listen when I call to give a long update on one of my babies who was recently seen there and they care about how your pets are doing! The Doctor's are really wonderful. I would recommend!

Hello Mike,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. I’m very sorry to hear … More

Boulevard Ravenswood is such a wonderful vet clinic. Our elder pup gets super anxious at the vet and shows her fear in ways that can be scary (big bark). Tech Cianna is absolutely wonderful with her and is incredible to work with. Her …

I had an absolutely incredible experience here with my dog Happy. After Happy had been experiencing some ear-related issues, I called my previous vet to schedule an appointment only to be told we couldn't be seen for 2 weeks! I couldn't …

Our dog, Spud, gets very nervous at the vet and normally goes through a lot of stress for appointments. This team was absolutely phenomenal with him and so patient. Special shout out to Uncle Logan, who showered Spud with love and made sure …
